Messages.Author: Ron de Langen
Messages.Body:
Hope you can help with this one.

When our group started playing Jyhad around four years ago, we used the
press to diablorize rule, but with all these newby players, they've
brought an interesting point; it doesn't say anything in the VTES rules
about being able to press to commit diablorie.
Please confirm the abolition of this rule, so our group can increase our
playing performance in adherence to the proper rules.

Messages.Author: PDB6
Messages.Body:
Ron de Langen wrote:
"When our group started playing Jyhad around four years ago, we used the press
to diablorize rule, but with all these newby players, they've brought an
interesting point; it doesn't say anything in the VTES rules about being able
to press to commit diablorie."

While I'm really not quite sure what "pressing to diabolrize" is (possibly a
rule out of the simplified introductory rules?), in the actual rules,
Diabolary only occurs A) when one vampire goes and diabolarizes another
vampire in Torpor or B) a vampire plays Amaranth in a combat where his
opponent is going to torpor. One cannot use a Press to commit diabolary.
